response.overview: The Dreamer (2015)  Created by independent artist MiRRoRMaN of AmigaCam.net, The Dreamer is an experimental horror film constructed entirely from footage taken from a collection of public domain and royalty-free classic movies.  The film transforms existing material into a new, unsettling nightmare, exploring themes of fear, desensitization, and the extremes of horror imagery. Created as an artistic experiment, The Dreamer pushes beyond traditional storytelling and challenges the viewer with an intense audiovisual experience designed to disturb, provoke, and leave a lasting impression.  Described by its creator as a "vile piece of shit" during production, the film represents an exploration of the darker side of creativity: the search for the point where art, fear, and experimentation collide.  A one-person independent production by MiRRoRMaN.
response.title: The Dreamer
